scope: Read-only static accounting of the 32 saved primary matrix reports, their inputs, the ledger and ownership registry, registered immutable module member inventories, and the saved supplementary reading reports. No UI verdict or pending-cause adjudication is performed here.
method: PowerShell built-in static file and JSON reads, followed by in-memory joins and comparisons of owner-declared values. No repository, harness, validator or verification code was executed.
hash_provenance: Every SHA-256 value is a supplied owner declaration. Equality here means recorded strings agree across the inspected JSON records; no file hash or image pixels were independently verified.
pointer_conventions: Each primary case's report and input pointers resolve against its batch report_path and input_path.
Ledger and primary owner pointers resolve against the two documents listed above.
Inventory member pointers resolve against that case's module inventory_path; the original artifact and reference paths and owner SHA strings remain in those records.
Case tuple fields omitted by a report are resolved from its explicit report run_id, round and freeze, with matching module and input declarations.
Viewing counts come from saved reports and their record aliases. Identical hashes or image content do not deduplicate separate declared opens.
Copied metadata comparisons are static owner JSON-field comparisons only. They provide no live process, lifecycle, runtime or pixel verification.
ledger_counter_gap_note: These are documentary accounting updates remaining in the ledger as last read. They are separate from immutable identity or artifact binding mismatches, and this audit does not modify or reconcile the ledger.

final_owner_capture_accounting.conclusion: The inspected ledger has no finalized owner capture inventory or final capture counts. The 101 manual matrix cases and 849 module member rows are scoped record counts, not final full-R1 capture counts.

preserved_root_scope.count_source: Parent dispatch records Root's actual confirmation of ten repair families. This audit retains the saved Root report pointers and does not independently adjudicate them.
preserved_root_scope.preservation_note: Raw worker findings and supplementary opinions remain distinct, immutable records with their own case identities and readers. Same-family observations do not borrow another case's image-viewing credit.

field_alias_notes.note: Reference original_uri values name the assigned immutable local mirror, while candidate original_uri values name the producer original. The reference values equal the bound reference paths; this path convention is an alias, not an identity mismatch.
Missing case-level run/round/source/binary fields are supplied by each saved report's explicit batch context and freeze. No missing optional field was converted to an identity mismatch.
The bound reference identity is stored in reference_viewing rather than reference.
